base_camera_unit:
[Unit]
Description=AURA shared USB camera preview and YOLOX person adapter
After=local-fs.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Environment="AURA_EXPERIMENT_GIL_MS=1"
Environment="AURA_PIPELINE_METRICS=1"
Environment="AURA_DPU_DIAGNOSTICS=1"
Environment="AURA_THREAD_SCHED_DIAGNOSTICS=switches"
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B /home/root/aura-dpu-vision-20261021/postpower-retry-live/release-reliability-f7624754038f-450136/runtime_entry.py /home/root/aura-dpu-vision-20261021/postpower-retry-live/release-reliability-f7624754038f-450136/aura/tools/board_camera_motion.py --config /home/root/aura-dpu-vision-20261021/postpower-retry-live/release-reliability-f7624754038f-450136/board_camera_ui.json
WorkingDirectory=/home/root/aura-dpu-vision-20261021/postpower-retry-live/release-reliability-f7624754038f-450136/aura
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
TimeoutStopSec=10
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
